status: DRAFT - pending human approval; expectations are per ILLUSTRATIVE profile

profiles.SP-A: fixed window L2/R2, strict > on both sides (PDF illustrative, not approved)
profiles.SP-B: L2/R2, left strict, right inclusive (first of a tie)
profiles.SP-C: L2/R2, left inclusive, right strict (last of a tie)
profiles.ML-A: label vs previous confirmed swing of the same kind: >, <, == -> HH/LH/EH, HL/LL/EL; first = NONE
profiles.TS-A: state as of close k-1: BULLISH if latest high label HH and latest low label HL; BEARISH if LH and LL; else UNKNOWN
profiles.RL: reference = latest confirmed swing of that kind, if unbroken
profiles.RH: reference = highest unbroken high / lowest unbroken low
profiles.dedup: one event per reference swing unless stated
profiles.break timing: break candle index > reference confirmed_index; event emitted at the break candle close

cases.description: PDF section 4 dataset verbatim: clear swing high, final low unconfirmed (end-of-series trap).
expected_non_events: no swing low at 7 (only 0 right bars)
no swing at 0/1 (insufficient left)
cases.rationale: PDF p4: 'swing high at i=2, confirmed at i=4. No confirmed swing low in this truncated sample.'

cases.description: SW01 plus two bars with lows above 6.0, as the PDF instructs: the low at 7 confirms at 9.
expected_non_events: L7 not available at k=7 or k=8
cases.rationale: PDF p4: 'Append two later bars with lows above 6.0 to test confirmation of i=7.'

cases.description: Mirror of SW01 (price' = 20 - price): clear swing low; final high unconfirmed.
expected_non_events: no swing high at 7
cases.rationale: High/low symmetry: same indices as SW01 with kinds swapped.

cases.description: Adjacent equal highs (14 at i=2 and i=3).
expected_non_events: SP-A: no unique strict pivot (PDF E3)
cases.rationale: Strict > rejects ties (PDF 2.B). The outcome depends on the tie policy; cluster policy would give ONE cluster {2,3} confirmed at 5.

cases.description: Double top: equal highs (14) four bars apart, separated by a swing low.
cases.rationale: Each peak is a strict pivot in its own window. The second high equals the first: HH/LH label undefined (EH).

cases.description: Adjacent equal lows (mirror of SW04).
expected_non_events: SP-A: no strict pivot low
cases.rationale: Mirror of SW04.

cases.description: Near-equal highs: 14.00 at i=2 and 13.99 at i=3 (one tick apart).
cases.rationale: Under raw-price strict comparison the 1-tick-higher bar is the pivot. A tolerance of >=1 tick turns this into a tie case.

cases.description: Candidate high at i=3 with only one right-side bar at the end of the data.
expected_non_events: SP-A: H3 stays a candidate (needs i=5)
cases.rationale: PDF E2 / end-of-dataset: insufficient right-side evidence -> unconfirmed. Must not be forced.

cases.description: Outside candle at i=2: highest high and lowest low of its window.
cases.rationale: PDF 7: outside bar -> allow both, reject both, or tie-break.

cases.description: Small swing (H5/L7) inside the advance to a larger top at i=10.
cases.rationale: Different windows give different structure; with 5/5 only the external top exists and it confirms 3 bars later.

cases.description: Candidate high at 2 rejected when bar 4 makes a higher high; bar 4 becomes the pivot.
expected_non_events: H2 never emitted (rejected at close of 4)
cases.rationale: A candidate is not an event: its rejection is not a repaint because it was never emitted.

cases.description: Late confirmation: candidate at 3.
expected_non_events: SP-A: nothing at k=3 or k=4
cases.rationale: PDF section 3: event_index 3, confirmed_index = 3 + R. Replay must emit at k=5.

cases.description: Plateau: three equal highs (14) at 2, 3, 4.
expected_non_events: SP-A: no pivot
cases.rationale: First / last / all / cluster: each tie policy gives a different answer.

cases.description: Equal high (14) reached again at the right-window boundary (i=4) after a lower bar.
expected_non_events: SP-A: H2 rejected at close of 4, H4 rejected by equal left neighbour
cases.rationale: Non-adjacent tie inside one window.

cases.description: Highest high on the very first bar (no left history).
expected_non_events: SP-A: bars 0-1 not eligible
cases.rationale: Insufficient left history: either ineligible or a relaxed start rule.

cases.description: Clean uptrend: L, H, HL, HH, HL.
expected_non_events: no label before a comparable earlier swing exists (first H and first L = NONE)
cases.rationale: Labels compare each swing with the previous confirmed swing of the same kind; labels exist from that swing's confirmation.

cases.description: Mirror of MS01: clean downtrend LH / LL.
cases.rationale: Mirror symmetry.

expected.TS-A state: UNKNOWN (EH is neither HH nor LH)

expected_non_events: no break: no close above 107.2

cases.description: Broadening: HH then LL (conflicting).
expected_non_events: no BOS/CHoCH label: state unknown
cases.rationale: Every sequence of pivots is not a trend; breaks exist but cannot be labelled.

cases.description: SW10 data: internal (2/2) vs external (5/5) structure.

expected_non_events: no swing H14 (rejected by bar 15)
no break event referencing bar 14
